reviewer: Codex deployment_review subagent; fresh bounded source review
scope: CloudFormation networking, IAM/S3, instance metadata restrictions and cost configuration
Bootstrap users, permission boundaries, IMDS owner firewall and service ordering
Crew/CLI artifact hash verification and safe archive members
Gateway systemd isolation and upstream AppArmor profile integration

resolved_findings.resolution: Exact hash-locked requirements plus pip --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: prevent version drift and source builds in this installation step.

limitations: Source/configuration review only; no cloud API calls, deployment or service execution performed by reviewer.
Runtime package installation, native sandbox behavior, firewall effectiveness, backend login, MCP enforcement and AWS allow/deny require separate host evidence.
Hashes bind dependency artifacts accepted by the lock; this is not an independent audit or publisher-signature verification of every dependency.
The generated lock may include hashes for multiple platform artifacts; installer permits binary wheels only.
